The First Cat Video Was Filmed in 1894 Two cats in gloves, a tiny ring, and a very patient trainer. "The Boxing Cats (Prof. Welton's)" was shot in about July 1894 inside Edison's Black Maria — a tar-paper shack in West Orange, New Jersey, and the world's first movie studio. The whole building sat on a track so the crew could shove it around to follow the sun. The cats belonged to Professor Henry Welton, who toured a circus of around forty trained cats: bicycles, hoops, somersaults, the lot. The boxing match was the closing act. The reel is about thirty-three feet long — twenty seconds — and people paid a nickel to watch it alone through a peephole in a Kinetoscope cabinet. One hundred and thirty years later, we're still watching cats on a screen. #history #cats #catvideo #archivalfootage #edison #1894 #vintage
